description: Dark-mode phone screenshot of Q drop #643, titled 'Rod Rosentein Red Line Marker' (misspelling of Rosenstein), posted 29 Jan 2018 under tripcode !UW.yye1fxo. The drop frames firing Rod Rosenstein ('RR') as a 'red line' tied to blocking or setting up the firing of Robert Mueller, and questions RR's role in blocking the FISA memo from Congressional review. A yellow oval hand-annotation circles the phrase '[4] OUTSIDE CONTRACTORS [NO C/TOP/SENS LEVEL CLEARANCE]'; the bottom lines of the drop are cut off.
text: 643. Rod Rosentein Red Line Marker. Q !UW.yye1fxo 29 Jan 2018 - 10:36:24 PM. Narrative shift. Nation on alert. Firing RR = block Mueller. Firing RR = set up to firing Mueller. Firing RR = Red line. What was the Senate conf vote re: RR? Why did RR [BEG] Ryan to block the FISA MEMO from Congressional review/further advancement? REAL TIME: [7] Congressional members + [3] Senators + [2] former O-senior officials + [4] OUTSIDE CONTRACTORS [NO C/TOP/SENS LEVEL CLEARANCE] @ SCIF [DC-CAP]. TOP SEC CLEARANCE IS MANDATORY
flags: Drop's claims about Rosenstein, Mueller and the FISA memo are unverified assertions from the Q post itself
Bottom of the drop is cut off in the screenshot

description: Black-and-white inspirational meme titled 'THE WARRIOR'. The left half shows a close-up profile of an unidentified bearded man wearing a medieval-style riveted helmet with a chainmail coif; the right half carries four maxims about a warrior's duty to protect family, guard honor and courage, and put duty above personal desire. Watermarked 'TheWisdomWarrior.com' in the lower-left corner.
text: THE WARRIOR. A warrior is the protector of his family and those in need. A warrior is the guardian of the ways of honor and courage. A warrior will not put his own desires above what is right. Above all, a warrior is always motivated by his utmost duty. TheWisdomWarrior.com
flags: Man in the photograph is an unidentified model/reenactor

description: Photoshopped meme built on the widely circulated photograph of James Comey standing arms-crossed in the middle of a rural two-lane road (from his October 2018 viral Iowa road tweet). A cartoon green bomb with a Pepe the Frog face, labeled 'MOAB', has been edited falling from the pink-tinted sky toward him, with the single caption 'Shit.' in typewriter font. MOAB in Q-follower usage means 'Mother Of All Bombs/Booms,' i.e. an imminent damaging revelation aimed at Comey.
flags: Identification of Comey rests on recognition of his well-known viral road photo used as the base image; the figure is not named in the image itself
